# Citing contoso

To cite this package in publications, use:

> 
> Hagan A (2025). _Contoso Dataset_.
<https://github.com/usrbinr/contoso>.

## BibTeX entry

```bibtex
@Manual{,
  title = {Contoso Dataset},
  author = {Alejandro Hagan},
  year = {2025},
  url = {https://github.com/usrbinr/contoso},
}
```
